name: Mauth
beschreibung: The Gasthof Mauth is located in the same-named district of Fließ, directly on the banks of the Inn. The rooms of the Gasthof are practical and traditionally furnished. The house has a guest garden with a terrace directly on the river. The furnishings are rustic, the management is family-run. It primarily appeals to active holidaymakers and independent travelers. The Gasthof is known for its in-house fish farm. Trout and char from this farm are served in the restaurant. The menu also includes classic Tiroler dishes.
